$sources: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82-3 (the horizontal capacity by an incremental analysis) with the parent's target displacement (ASCE 41-17)

procedure.source: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 82-3 (the incremental analysis under the Ai-distributed seismic forces: SAEngine practice for the load pattern)
procedure.note: The pushover takes the equivalent static seismic forces (Ai distribution) as its pattern; the storeys' Qu for the horizontal capacity check are read from it (horizontalCapacity). The target displacement, the hinges and the member acceptance stay the parent's ASCE 41-17 methods (not the law's), with the spectrum at the ultimate level Z Rt C0 = 1.0.

targetDisplacement.source: The parent's ASCE 41-17 displacement coefficient method on the pack's spectrum Z Rt C0 with C0 = 0.2 / R, R = 0.2: the ultimate level C0 = 1.0 (SAEngine practice)
targetDisplacement.note: The law has no target displacement: SAEngine reads Sa at the ultimate standard shear coefficient (R = 0.2 on C0 = 0.2). The site factor a of C1 (ASCE 41 Table 7-3) is taken 90 for soil type 1 and 60 for types 2 and 3 (SAEngine practice).
